fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code where the account was opened/operated from.

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CONTRACT ID
fields.description: Unique number assigned to lndividual deposit contracts

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Customer unique id linked to the deposit contract

fields.name: COUNTERPARTY ID
fields.description: A unique identifer for the counterparty where deposits are held. E.g. SWIFT Code

fields.name: CONTRACT COMMENCEMENT DATE
fields.description: The date when the contract was commenced. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}.

fields.name: CONTRACT MATURITY DATE
fields.description: The date when the contract will mature, otherwise left blank for demand deposits. Format {DD-MMM- YYYY}.

fields.name: SETTLEMENT DATE
fields.description: Date on which the obligation of the contract is due for payment or honor. (Date when the contract was settled). Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}.

fields.name: ACCOUNT TYPE
fields.description: Type of deposit account {e.g. Demand deposits, Savings Deposits, Call Deposits, Fixed Deposits, Mobile Phone Deposits, etc.}

fields.name: TENURE
fields.description: The term period for the deposit contract in days.

fields.name: DEPOSIT INTEREST RATE
fields.description: The rate of interest rate marked on the deposit contract

fields.name: BASE RATE
fields.description: The reporting institution's reference rate.

fields.name: ANTICIPATED MATURITY PERIOD
fields.description: The anticipated maturity period. E.g. Matured, 0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 6-9 months, 10-12 months, 1-3 years, 3-5 years and over 5 years

fields.name: ISO CURRENCY CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: PRINCIPAL OUTSTANDING AMOUNT FCY
fields.description: Pricipal outstanding amount of deposit in foreign currency.

fields.name: PRINCIPAL OUTSTANDING AMOUNT LCY
fields.description: Pricipal outstanding amount of deposit in the local currency equivalent (KES).

fields.name: INTEREST AMOUNT FCY
fields.description: Interest amount earned by the customer in foreign currency.

fields.name: INTEREST AMOUNT LCY
fields.description: Interest amount earned by the customer in the local currency equivalent (KES).

fields.name: ACCRUED INTEREST FCY
fields.description: Interest amount accrued but not yet applied. Owing to the customer in foreign currency.

fields.name: ACCRUED INTEREST LCY
fields.description: Interest amount accrued but not yet applied. Owing to the customer in the local currency equivalent (KES).

fields.name: CONTRACT STATUS
fields.description: E.g. Active, Pre-Matured and Matured.
